answers.core: So I wanted to introduce this proposal, as this seems helpful for many other use cases since Godot has the powerful multiselect/multiedit features when selecting nodes of the same type. (See my examples above under "describe the feature")
answers.workaround: The workaround depending on the scene tree can be brutal. For me, I had about 20 nodes, so it was a time saver of 10-15 seconds. But the code change seems small (I'd love to hear a GD dev's feedback on that area).

title: Add a way to filter nodes by type in the Scene tree dock
